error.offline: govee-server does not answer. Make sure that it runs, then reload the page.
error.outdated: This govee-server is older than Studio. Update govee-server, start it again, then reload the page.
error.unreadable: govee-server sent an answer that Studio cannot read. Update govee-server and Studio to the same version.
mobile.title: Open Studio on a phone or tablet
mobile.scan: Scan the code with the camera of a phone or a tablet on the same network.
mobile.off: Share Studio on this network, then scan the code with a phone or a tablet.
mobile.warning: While sharing is on, any device on this network can control the lights.
mobile.fixed: govee-server listens on the network (--listen): any device on it can control the lights.
mobile.elsewhere: Only the computer that runs govee-server can switch sharing.
settings.data.elsewhere: Only the computer that runs govee-server can export or import: the file can hold the API key.
data.confirm.title: Replace the current configuration?
data.confirm.body: Your current devices and settings will be replaced by the ones in this file. You can restore them afterwards.
data.restore.hint: Put back the devices and settings from before the last import
data.restore.title: Restore the previous configuration?
data.restore.body: Studio goes back to the devices and settings that you had before the last import.
